title: Part 7 — Triple passage 1: course advert, email and schedule
instructionsVi: Bộ ba văn bản, 5 câu. Dạng khó nhất của TOEIC Reading: ít nhất hai câu đòi hỏi ghép thông tin từ hai văn bản khác nhau, và một câu tính toán nhiều bước.
promptEn: Refer to the following advertisement, email and schedule, then answer the questions.
passage:
ADVERTISEMENT
WESTGATE BUSINESS SKILLS — Autumn Short Courses
All courses run at our Riverside campus, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

· Negotiation Essentials — Tuesdays — $240
· Data Presentation — Wednesdays — $195
· Project Scheduling — Thursdays — $260
· Business Writing — Fridays — $180

Early-bird discount: 15% off any course booked before 15 September.
Group discount: book three or more places on the same course and receive a further 10% off the discounted price.

---

EMAIL
From: t.okoye@lambertco.example
To: bookings@westgateskills.example
Date: 8 September
Subject: Autumn course booking

Hello,

I would like to book places for four members of my team on the Project Scheduling course. All four can attend on the advertised day.

I note from your website that the Riverside campus is being refurbished this autumn. Could you confirm where the course will actually be held?

One further question: two of my team will travel from our Eastbrook office. Is there parking on site?

Regards,
Temi Okoye

---

SCHEDULE (revised 5 September)
Westgate Business Skills — Autumn term venue changes

Due to refurbishment work at Riverside, the following courses will be held at the Meadowbank Centre instead:
· Project Scheduling (Thursdays)
· Business Writing (Fridays)

Negotiation Essentials and Data Presentation remain at Riverside.
Meadowbank Centre has no on-site parking; the nearest public car park is on Fenn Street, a five-minute walk away.

questions.prompt: 186. Where will Ms Okoye's team attend their course?

options.text: Riverside campus
Eastbrook office
Meadowbank Centre
Fenn Street

questions.explanationVi: Email đặt khoá Project Scheduling; lịch sửa đổi cho biết khoá này chuyển sang Meadowbank. Phải ghép email với lịch.

questions.prompt: 187. What is the price per place for Ms Okoye's booking?
questions.explanationVi: Đặt ngày 8/9 nên được giảm sớm 15%: 260 × 0,85 = 221. Đặt 4 chỗ nên giảm thêm 10% trên giá ĐÃ giảm: 221 × 0,9 = 198,90. Bẫy là (C), tức quên mức giảm thứ hai.

questions.prompt: 188. What is the answer to Ms Okoye's parking question?

options.text: There is free parking at the venue.
There is no on-site parking; a public car park is nearby.
Parking must be booked in advance.
Parking is only available at Riverside.

questions.explanationVi: 'Meadowbank Centre has no on-site parking; the nearest public car park is on Fenn Street'.

questions.prompt: 189. Which course was NOT affected by the venue change?

options.text: Project Scheduling
Business Writing
All courses moved.
Data Presentation

questions.explanationVi: 'Negotiation Essentials and Data Presentation remain at Riverside'.

questions.prompt: 190. On which day of the week will the team attend?

options.text: Thursday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Friday

questions.explanationVi: Project Scheduling chạy vào thứ Năm theo quảng cáo, và lịch sửa đổi giữ nguyên ngày, chỉ đổi địa điểm.

title: Part 7 — Triple passage 2: policy, claim form and reply
instructionsVi: Bộ ba văn bản. Câu hỏi buộc ÁP DỤNG một điều khoản trong văn bản 1 vào tình huống ở văn bản 2 để suy ra kết quả ở văn bản 3.
promptEn: Refer to the following policy extract, claim form and email, then answer the questions.
passage:
POLICY EXTRACT — Meridian Equipment Warranty

1. Standard cover lasts 24 months from the date of delivery.
2. Cover is extended to 36 months where the customer has purchased an annual service plan and all scheduled services have been completed.
3. Damage caused by operation outside the stated temperature range (5°C to 40°C) is excluded from all cover.
4. Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the fault being discovered.
5. Notwithstanding clause 3, cover applies where the customer can show that the temperature excursion resulted from a failure of equipment supplied by Meridian.

---

CLAIM FORM — submitted 14 April

Customer: Halloway Cold Storage
Unit: Meridian CX-40 compressor
Date of delivery: 3 March, two years and one month ago
Annual service plan: Yes — services completed March (year 1) and March (year 2)
Fault discovered: 2 April
Description: Compressor failed after the unit's own thermostat, also supplied by Meridian, stopped regulating and allowed the chamber to reach 46°C overnight.

---

EMAIL
From: claims@meridianequip.example
To: j.halloway@hallowaycold.example
Date: 21 April
Subject: Claim MC-2214

Dear Ms Halloway,

Thank you for your claim, which we have now assessed. I can confirm that we will repair the compressor at no charge and replace the thermostat unit at the same visit.

Our engineer is available on 28 or 29 April. Please confirm which you prefer.

Regards,
Claims Team

questions.prompt: 191. Why is the unit still covered despite being more than 24 months old?

options.text: Because an annual service plan was held and all services were completed
Because the fault was discovered within 30 days
Because the customer is a long-standing client
Because compressors have a separate warranty period

questions.explanationVi: Điều 2: có gói bảo dưỡng năm và hoàn thành đủ các lần bảo dưỡng thì cover kéo dài 36 tháng. Máy mới 25 tháng nên vẫn trong hạn.

questions.prompt: 192. Why does the temperature exclusion not apply here?

options.text: Because 46°C is within the stated range
Because the fault occurred overnight
Because the excursion was caused by Meridian's own thermostat failing
Because clause 3 was removed from the policy

questions.explanationVi: Điều 5 là ngoại lệ của điều 3: nếu vượt nhiệt do thiết bị của chính Meridian hỏng thì vẫn được bảo hành.

questions.prompt: 193. Was the claim submitted in time?

options.text: No — it was submitted after 30 days
Yes — but only because the deadline was waived
The policy does not set a deadline.
Yes — 12 days after the fault was discovered

questions.explanationVi: Phát hiện lỗi ngày 2/4, nộp ngày 14/4 — cách nhau 12 ngày, trong hạn 30 ngày của điều 4.

questions.prompt: 194. What is NOT mentioned in the email?

options.text: The compressor will be repaired free of charge.
The warranty will be extended by a further year.
The thermostat will be replaced.
Two possible visit dates are offered.

questions.explanationVi: Email nêu ba việc đầu, hoàn toàn không nhắc tới gia hạn bảo hành. Dạng NOT buộc đối chiếu từng phương án.

questions.prompt: 195. What is Ms Halloway asked to do?

options.text: Submit further evidence
Pay a contribution towards the repair
Choose between two visit dates
Return the compressor to Meridian

questions.explanationVi: 'Our engineer is available on 28 or 29 April. Please confirm which you prefer'.

title: Part 7 — Triple passage 3: job advert, application and interview note
instructionsVi: Bộ ba văn bản cuối cùng của đề. Có một câu hỏi hàm ý và một câu đối chiếu yêu cầu tuyển dụng với hồ sơ ứng viên.
promptEn: Refer to the following advertisement, email and note, then answer the questions.
passage:
ADVERTISEMENT
WAREHOUSE SUPERVISOR — Halloran Distribution, Fairport

Evening shift, Monday to Friday, 2 p.m. to 10 p.m. Permanent.

Essential: three years' warehouse experience; valid forklift certificate; available to start by 1 June.
Desirable: experience with stock management software; a second language.

Applications close 30 April. Interviews week commencing 6 May.
Apply to recruitment@halloran.example with a CV and covering letter.

---

EMAIL
From: s.mensah@example.com
To: recruitment@halloran.example
Date: 24 April
Subject: Warehouse Supervisor application

Dear Recruitment team,

Please find attached my CV for the Warehouse Supervisor position.

I have five years' experience in warehousing, the last two as a shift leader at Kesten Logistics, where I introduced the stock scanning system now used across all three of their sites. I hold a current forklift certificate, renewed in January, and I speak Portuguese as well as English.

I should mention that I am currently serving a notice period which ends on 10 June. I hope this does not rule me out, and I would be glad to discuss it.

Regards,
Selina Mensah

---

INTERVIEW NOTE — 8 May
Candidate: S. Mensah · Panel: R. Beck, I. Duarte

Strong on the operational questions; clearly the most experienced candidate seen this week. Handled the scenario on managing an underperforming team member particularly well.

Only issue is the start date. Panel agreed the June deadline was set for the summer peak and there is some flexibility. R. Beck to check with Operations whether a mid-June start is workable before we make an offer.

questions.prompt: 196. Which essential requirement does Ms Mensah NOT meet?

options.text: Three years' warehouse experience
Availability by 1 June
A valid forklift certificate
She meets all essential requirements.

questions.explanationVi: Yêu cầu bắt buộc là bắt đầu trước 1/6, nhưng bà ấy hết hạn báo trước ngày 10/6. Phải đối chiếu quảng cáo với email.

questions.prompt: 197. Which desirable criteria does she meet?

options.text: Both
Neither
Stock management software only
A second language only

questions.explanationVi: Bà ấy triển khai hệ thống quét kho VÀ nói được tiếng Bồ Đào Nha — đủ cả hai tiêu chí mong muốn.

questions.prompt: 198. What does the interview note suggest about the start date requirement?

options.text: It cannot be changed under any circumstances.
It has already been extended to July.
It applies only to temporary staff.
It was set for a reason that may allow some flexibility.

questions.explanationVi: 'the June deadline was set for the summer peak and there is some flexibility'.

questions.prompt: 199. What must happen before an offer is made?

options.text: References must be obtained.
A second interview must be held.
Operations must confirm a mid-June start is workable.
The forklift certificate must be verified.

questions.explanationVi: 'R. Beck to check with Operations whether a mid-June start is workable before we make an offer'.

questions.prompt: 200. What is implied about the other candidates?

options.text: None of them held a forklift certificate.
They had less experience than Ms Mensah.
They were all available from 1 June.
They were interviewed in a different week.

questions.explanationVi: 'clearly the most experienced candidate seen this week' — hàm ý những người khác kinh nghiệm ít hơn. Ba phương án kia không có căn cứ trong bài.
